## Proyecto Aprendizaje de Maquina - Hoteles Kaggle

```{r}
# Convert tring month to a numeric value
month_to_number <- function(x){
  if      (x == "January"){1}
  else if (x == "February"){2}
  else if (x == "March"){3}
  else if (x == "April"){4}
  else if (x == "May"){5}
  else if (x == "June"){6}
  else if (x == "July"){7}		
  else if (x == "August"){8}
  else if (x == "September"){9}
  else if (x == "October"){10}
  else if (x == "November"){11}			
  else if (x == "December"){12}
}

hoteles <- read.csv("Datos/entrena.csv")

# Convertimos los meses a valores numericos
hoteles <- hoteles |> mutate(month_as_number = map_dbl(arrival_date_month, month_to_number))

# Creamos la variable de fecha para poder acomodarlos en el tiempo
hoteles <- hoteles |> 
  mutate(fecha = paste(arrival_date_year, month_as_number, arrival_date_day_of_month) |>
                as.Date(format = '%Y %m %d')) |>
  arrange(by = fecha)


hoteles <- hoteles |>
  mutate(igual_reservado = ifelse(reserved_room_type == assigned_room_type, 1,0)) |> 
  mutate(arrival_date_month = factor(arrival_date_month),
         is_repeated_guest = factor(is_repeated_guest),
         customer_type = factor(customer_type),
         hotel = factor(hotel),
         arrival_date_year = factor(arrival_date_year),
         arrival_date_week_number = factor(arrival_date_week_number),
         deposit_type = factor(deposit_type),
         assigned_room_type = factor(assigned_room_type),
         reserved_room_type = factor(reserved_room_type),
         distribution_channel = factor(distribution_channel),
         market_segment = factor(market_segment),
         meal = factor(meal),
         days_in_waiting_list=log(days_in_waiting_list+1E-16),
         booking_changes=log(booking_changes+1E-16))  |>
  mutate(costo_total = ifelse(stays_in_week_nights + stays_in_weekend_nights == 0, adr,
                              (stays_in_week_nights+stays_in_weekend_nights)*adr))

hoteles$children[is.na(hoteles$children)] <- 0 # Si ninios es NA entonces se va a 0 (la mediana), solo hay 4 NA. 

# the most common countries
cc <- c('PRT', 'NULL', 'GBR', 'FRA', 'ESP', 'DEU', 'ITA', 'IRL', 'BEL','NLD', 'BRA', 'USA', 'CHE')
# the most common agents
ca <- c('9', 'NULL', '240', '1', '6', '7', '14', '250', '28','3', '8', '241', '37')
# the most common companies
ccs <- c('NULL', '40', '223', '67', '45', '281', '174', '153', '219', '154', '223')

for (i in 1:length(hoteles$country)){
if(hoteles$country[i] %in% cc == FALSE){
  hoteles$country[i] <- 'otros'
}}

for (i in 1:length(hoteles$agent)){
if(hoteles$agent[i] %in% ca == FALSE){
  hoteles$agent[i] <- 'otros'
}}

for (i in 1:length(hoteles$company)){
if(hoteles$company[i] %in% ccs == FALSE){
  hoteles$company[i] <- 'otros'
}}

hoteles <- hoteles %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country), agent = factor(agent), company = factor(company)) 

# prueba factor, 62 niveles si a lo mejor acepta hasta 60 niveles 
```

```{r}
set.seed(11283)
hoteles_split = initial_split(hoteles, prop = 0.70)
hoteles_ent <- training(hoteles_split)
```

```{r}
receta_hoteles <- recipe(is_canceled ~ lead_time + 
                                       stays_in_weekend_nights +
                                       stays_in_week_nights +
                                       adults +
                                       children +
                                       babies +
                                       previous_cancellations +
                                       previous_bookings_not_canceled +
                                       booking_changes +
                                       days_in_waiting_list +
                                       adr +
                                       total_of_special_requests +
                                       required_car_parking_spaces + # aqui nominales
                                       is_repeated_guest +
                                       customer_type +
                                       hotel +
                                       arrival_date_year +
                                       arrival_date_month +
                                       arrival_date_week_number +
                                       meal +
                                       market_segment +
                                       distribution_channel +
                                       assigned_room_type +
                                       deposit_type +
                                       country +
                                       agent +
                                       company +
                                       igual_reservado + 
                                       costo_total +
                                       reserved_room_type,
           data = hoteles_ent) %>% 
  step_novel(country,agent) %>% # nuevos en categoria nueva 
  step_unknown(country,agent) %>% #faltantes en categoria nueva ?
  step_dummy(is_repeated_guest,customer_type,hotel,arrival_date_year,arrival_date_month,
             arrival_date_week_number,meal,market_segment, reserved_room_type,
             distribution_channel,assigned_room_type,deposit_type,country,agent, company) %>%
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("arrival_date_month"):starts_with("arrival_date_year")) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("customer_type"):starts_with("hotel") ) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("deposit_type"):starts_with("is_repeated_guest") ) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ adr:starts_with("reserved_room_type") ) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("total_of_special_requests"):starts_with("customer_type") ) |>
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("total_of_special_requests"):starts_with("country") ) |> 
  step_interact(terms = ~ lead_time:starts_with("is_repeated_guest") ) |> 
  step_interact(terms = ~ lead_time:days_in_waiting_list )
  
```

```{r}
modelo_logistico <-
boost_tree(trees = 200, mode = "classification") |>
set_engine("xgboost")
```

```{r}
flujo <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(receta_hoteles) %>% 
  add_model(modelo_logistico) 
flujo_ajustado <- fit(flujo, hoteles_ent)
```

```{r}
modelo_ajustado <- flujo_ajustado %>% extract_fit_parsnip()
coeficientes_tbl <- modelo_ajustado %>% tidy() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) %>% 
  select(-penalty)
```

```{r}
conjunto_wfs <- workflow_set(
  preproc = list(receta_base = receta_hoteles),
  models = list(reg_logistica = modelo_logistico),
  cross = FALSE
)
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
val_split <- manual_rset(hoteles_split %>% list(), "validacion")
mis_metricas <- metric_set(mn_log_loss, accuracy)
resultados <- conjunto_wfs %>% 
  workflow_map("fit_resamples", resamples = val_split, 
               metrics = mis_metricas)

resultados %>% select(wflow_id, result) %>% 
  unnest(result) %>% unnest(.metrics)
```



```{r}
modelo_final <- flujo_ajustado
hoteles_prueba <- read.csv("Datos/prueba.csv") %>%
  mutate(arrival_date_month = factor(arrival_date_month),
         is_repeated_guest = factor(is_repeated_guest),
         customer_type = factor(customer_type),
         hotel = factor(hotel),
         arrival_date_year = factor(arrival_date_year),
         arrival_date_week_number = factor(arrival_date_week_number),
         deposit_type = factor(deposit_type),
         assigned_room_type = factor(assigned_room_type),
         distribution_channel = factor(distribution_channel),
         market_segment = factor(market_segment),
         meal = factor(meal),
         days_in_waiting_list=log(days_in_waiting_list+1E-16),
         booking_changes=log(booking_changes+1E-16)) |>
  mutate(igual_reservado = ifelse(reserved_room_type == assigned_room_type, 1,0)) |> 
  mutate(costo_total = ifelse(stays_in_week_nights + stays_in_weekend_nights == 0, adr,
                              (stays_in_week_nights+stays_in_weekend_nights)*adr))

hoteles_prueba$children[is.na(hoteles_prueba$children)] <- 0 # Si ninios es NA entonces se va a 0 (la mediana), solo hay 4 NA. 

# the most common countries
cc <- c('PRT', 'NULL', 'GBR', 'FRA', 'ESP', 'DEU', 'ITA', 'IRL', 'BEL','NLD', 'BRA', 'USA', 'CHE')
# the most common agents
ca <- c('9', 'NULL', '240', '1', '6', '7', '14', '250', '28','3', '8', '241', '37')
# the most common companies
ccs <- c('NULL', '40', '223', '67', '45', '281', '174', '153', '219', '154', '223')

for (i in 1:length(hoteles_prueba$country)){
if(hoteles_prueba$country[i] %in% cc == FALSE){
  hoteles_prueba$country[i] <- 'otros'
}}

for (i in 1:length(hoteles_prueba$agent)){
if(hoteles_prueba$agent[i] %in% ca == FALSE){
  hoteles_prueba$agent[i] <- 'otros'
}}

for (i in 1:length(hoteles_prueba$company)){
if(hoteles_prueba$company[i] %in% ccs == FALSE){
  hoteles_prueba$company[i] <- 'otros'
}}

hoteles_prueba <- hoteles_prueba %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country), agent = factor(agent), company = factor(company))
submission <- tibble(id = hoteles_prueba$id, prob = predict(modelo_final, hoteles_prueba, type = "prob")$.pred_cancelado )
```
